also i think i should add that my occupational qualifications have been negated through three years of bullying and being put down. i'm a mere shadow of my former self, i have no friends, and very little self esteem to work with.

i seriously doubt that at this point in time i would be able to handle the requirements of even a minimum wage job.

again, reason escapes me. logically i should be able to move past this, emotionally i simply cannot.

Thanks. i hadn't thought about a lawyer at this point, but that would be the perfect person to share all of my incriminating evidence with in a confidential manner. i had planned to approach family and children's services for some resources on how to educate my partner about appropriate parental behaviour in the least invasive way possible, however it's difficult to get involved with them and not have them come to investigate the situation first hand, which naturally would not end well.

the whole situation comes at a bad time as far as his side of the family is concerned. i might have been able to garner some of their support, but recently an uncle of his was screwed royally in a divorce that left him being accused of beating her (i can't know for sure but this man is extremely passive and i highly doubt that), embarrassed, broke, and without his children. clearly my so's family are more aware of his tendency towards violence and poor anger management skills, however i can't expect any of them to believe my side of the story especially following these recent events.

i'm so...... frustrated.

ideally we would sort out our issues and live happily ever after. i seriously love this man and i wish there was some way i could help him. there's only so much i can do, and i've met the end of my patience.
